verdict.rationale: Yapily is an open banking API platform. A platform of this kind could plausibly offer configurable automations, so the axis applies. The evidence covers scheduled and recurring payments, webhooks, and a docs MCP server, but nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations. Scheduled payments and webhooks are adjacent features, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
